name: OCD Panel (SaaS)
description: Multi-tenant deployment panel with org-based access control, member management, billing, and granular permissions.

env.description: Secret key for signing JWT tokens. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
Public origin of this deployment (e.g. https://saas.example.com). Used for Stripe return URLs and absolute links.
WebAuthn Relying Party ID — the bare hostname (e.g. saas.example.com), no scheme or port.
WebAuthn expected origin (e.g. https://saas.example.com). Must match APP_PUBLIC_HOST.
Set to 1 when running behind a trusted reverse proxy (Caddy in front of the container). Enables X-Forwarded-For for rate limiting.
Explicit CORS origin. Leave empty for same-origin only.
GitHub OAuth App client ID (enables repo linking and private image pulls).
Stripe secret key (sk_live_... or sk_test_...). Required for billing.
Stripe publishable key (pk_live_... or pk_test_...). Exposed to the browser.
Stripe Price ID for the per-seat subscription plan.
Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_...). Required to verify incoming webhook events.
Require 2FA for all users. Set to 0 to disable.
Number of dedicated engine processes. 0 = embedded engine in server (default). 2+ for horizontal scaling.
Max concurrent deploy operations per engine instance.
